findings.name: Unauthenticated SLA Endpoints
findings.finding: /api/v1/sla/alerts and /api/v1/sla/milestones/active return full data without authentication, exposing lead IDs, user IDs, and operational data to the public internet.
findings.impact: Data leak of internal CRM operational state. External actors can enumerate lead and user IDs.
findings.recommendation: Add Depends(get_current_user) to both endpoints in backend/routes/sla_tracking_routes.py.

findings.name: Disconnected SLA Systems
findings.finding: sla_milestones_canonical.json defines 27 milestones but is NOT consumed by runtime code. workflow_sla_service.py uses database tables exclusively. CLAUDE.md SLA_TARGETS defines a third set of 7 transitions.
findings.impact: Three SLA truth sources with no bridge. Config changes to canonical JSON have zero runtime effect.
findings.recommendation: Choose one source of truth: load canonical JSON at startup to seed DB, or deprecate the JSON file.

findings.name: No Loan-Side SLA Auto-Enrollment on Handoff
findings.finding: Lead-to-Disclosed transition creates a task and starts drip campaigns but does NOT call WorkflowSLAService.enroll_loan(). Loan-phase SLA milestones never fire automatically.
findings.impact: All 19 loan-phase SLA milestones are effectively dead. LOs must manually enroll each loan.
findings.recommendation: Add enroll_loan() call in lead_workflow_engine.py _handle_to_disclosed() after loan file creation.

findings.name: Self-Referential Trigger Conditions
findings.finding: clear_to_close milestone triggers from 'Clear To Close' (itself). documents_received triggers from 'Documents Requested' which is inactive.
findings.impact: clear_to_close SLA can never trigger automatically. documents_received deadline depends on inactive milestone.
findings.recommendation: Fix clear_to_close.trigger_from to 'conditions_cleared'. Reactivate documents_requested or change trigger source.

findings.name: Disclosed State Dead-End
findings.finding: VALID_TRANSITIONS['Disclosed'] = ['Closed'] only. No recovery path back to Pre-Approved, Long-Term Nurture, or Withdrawn.
findings.impact: Leads stuck in Disclosed with failed deals have no legitimate recovery path without manual DB edits.
findings.recommendation: Add recovery transitions: Disclosed -> [Closed, Long-Term Nurture, Withdrawn, Does Not Qualify].

findings.name: Inconsistent Lead Stage Definitions
findings.finding: database/enums.py, lead_workflow_engine.py LEAD_STAGES, and VALID_TRANSITIONS define different stage sets. Application Started/Complete handlers are dead code.
findings.impact: Maintenance confusion. Dead handlers give false sense of coverage.
findings.recommendation: Align all three sources. Remove dead handler code.

findings.name: DNQ Re-Entry Gap
findings.finding: Does Not Qualify -> Prospect/Application is valid but no workflow re-enrollment triggers on re-entry.
findings.impact: Re-entering leads miss intake workflow and first-contact SLAs.
findings.recommendation: Add re-enrollment hook in Prospect handler for previously-DNQ leads.

findings.name: Dead Code Handlers
findings.finding: Handlers for Application Started and Application Complete (lines 157-168) reference stages not in VALID_TRANSITIONS. Never execute.
findings.impact: False sense of coverage. Maintenance burden.
findings.recommendation: Remove dead handlers or add stages to VALID_TRANSITIONS.

findings.name: Bidirectional Loop Risk
findings.finding: Attempted Contact <-> Prospect <-> Application creates bidirectional loops. No guard prevents rapid cycling.
findings.impact: Potential flood of duplicate tasks from rapid stage cycling.
findings.recommendation: Add cooldown mechanism or max-transition counter.

findings.name: Invisible Unassigned Tasks
findings.finding: When role resolution fails and lead.owner_id is NULL, linked task in tasks table is never created. Workflow task instance exists but is invisible in UI.
findings.impact: Tasks silently dropped. No visibility into assignment failures.
findings.recommendation: Always create linked task even if unassigned. Add Unassigned filter to task dashboard.

findings.name: No Backpressure on Task Generation
findings.finding: MAX_PENDING_TASKS_PER_USER=50. Over-capacity assigns to first user anyway with no alert or redistribution.
findings.impact: Overloaded LOs. No manager visibility into capacity issues.
findings.recommendation: Add alert when users exceed 40 pending tasks. Consider pausing generation for overloaded roles.

findings.name: Partial Time-Based Rules
findings.finding: application_incomplete checks for 'Application Started' (wrong stage). preapproval_expiring (30 days) has no handler implementation.
findings.impact: Two time-based automations non-functional. Leads may go unattended.
findings.recommendation: Fix stage name. Implement preapproval_expiring handler.

findings.name: Loan Stages Consistent
findings.finding: LoanStage enum (21 stages) matches across database/enums.py and CLAUDE.md. TERMINAL_STAGES correctly identified.

findings.name: Start States Defined
findings.finding: Lead workflow: VALID_TRANSITIONS[None] = ['New']. Workflow instance: created as 'active'. Both correctly defined.

findings.name: Milestone Registry Complete
findings.finding: 27 milestones defined across 5 phases. 25 active, 2 inactive (documents_requested, closing_date).

findings.name: Instance State Machine Clean
findings.finding: States: active, paused, completed, cancelled. All transitions guarded with status checks. No invalid paths.

findings.name: Alert Lifecycle Complete
findings.finding: Alert states: active -> acknowledged -> resolved (with snooze/escalate side operations). Complete lifecycle.

findings.name: Task Type Routing Complete
findings.finding: 11 task types mapped to 5 routes (task_list, sms_automation, email_automation, dialer_queue, ai_autonomous).

findings.name: AI-Eligible Types Properly Gated
findings.finding: AI_ELIGIBLE_TYPES = {email, text, text_am, text_pm}. Gated by day_config ai_responsible flag. Thresholds: 95% auto-execute, 70% review.

findings.name: Task Deduplication Working
findings.finding: Dedup checks at both workflow_task_instances and tasks levels. Returns existing ID if duplicate found.

findings.name: SLA Hook Tasks Well-Structured
findings.finding: 5 score bands + 6 flag hooks. All have valid assignee roles, unique codes, reasonable SLA targets. No circular deps.

findings.name: Sibling Cancellation Correct
findings.finding: Sibling tasks share task_group_key. Cancellation triggers on contact_made=True. Also cancels SLA warning tasks.

findings.name: Enrollment Validation Working
findings.finding: Both enroll_lead and enroll_loan validate entity existence, config existence, and prevent duplicate active enrollments.

findings.name: Config Inheritance Working
findings.finding: Two-tier lookup: org-specific config first, then system template fallback. Correctly supports per-org customization.

findings.name: Legacy/SLA Coordination Correct
findings.finding: Lead workflow engine checks _check_active_sla_workflow before executing legacy actions. Prevents duplicate actions.

findings.name: Task Statuses Functional
findings.finding: Task instance statuses (scheduled, pending, in_progress, completed, skipped, failed, cancelled) all handled correctly. Minor inconsistency: task_generator uses 'scheduled', sla_service uses 'pending' for initial status.
findings.recommendation: Consider standardizing initial status to one value.

findings.name: Duration Types Documented
findings.finding: Four target types: hours (3), business_days (20), business_days_before (2), calendar_days (2). All milestones have defined durations.

findings.name: API Health Check
findings.finding: GET /api/v1/health returned 200 in 103ms. Database connected. Version 2026.01.22.1.

findings.name: Task Health Checks
findings.finding: Workflow dashboard endpoint requires JWT authentication. Could not retrieve task distribution data.
findings.recommendation: Configure API_TOKEN for future audits to enable live checks.

findings.name: SLA Compliance Rates
findings.finding: SLA dashboard summary endpoint requires authentication. However, unauthenticated alerts endpoint shows 50 active overdue alerts (38 preapproval, 12 lead_response).
findings.recommendation: 50 overdue alerts with 0 acknowledgments suggests SLA monitoring may not be active.

findings.name: Routing Distribution Checks
findings.finding: Task distribution data requires authenticated access.
